post.description: Authorize and idempotently queue a human customer reply; takeover and current authorship are enforced server-side.

get.description: Return scoped conversation, ordered messages, latest quotation, and delivery records for the working inbox.

post.description: Create a local-test customer request, initial message, and durable agent job in one transaction.
Persist an authenticated staff note idempotently; this endpoint does not impersonate a customer or send externally.
Accept a staff-operated local-test customer reply, invalidate old decisions, and enqueue permitted automation.
Version-check a staff ownership change and block queued automation on takeover in the same transaction.
Validate an expected conversation version and authoritative products, then create a new immutable quotation revision.
Authorize and idempotently record the exact-revision staff decision under the stricter approval admission limit.

get.description: Authorize a quotation and stream its canonical private PDF, creating it once from the stored revision if absent.

post.description: Retrieve company-scoped descriptive candidates with source versions/pages, without calculating commercial terms.

schema.title: Response Search Api Catalog Search Post

get.description: Authorize a catalog source and stream its private original PDF without exposing Storage credentials or URLs.
Read company-scoped workspace collections and actual stored aggregates for the authorized staff view.
Stream bounded authenticated refresh notifications; membership is rechecked before every event.

post.description: Accept at most 10 MB of actual streamed bytes within 30 seconds; filenames/MIME never establish trusted audio content.
Accept at most 5 MB of actual bytes; decoding and label reading run later in a durable bounded job.

get.description: Stream only the authorized sandbox-normalized WAV; never disclose a private Storage URL or arbitrary original.
Stream only an authorized sandbox-normalized JPEG; original metadata and private Storage paths stay server-side.
Read the company's stock table (on hand, reserved, available, reorder level, low flag) for any staff member.
Read a newest-first page of stock movements, optionally for one product, using the `before` cursor.

post.description: Idempotently apply an administrator's stock correction with a mandatory reason (403 for other roles).
Idempotently set one product's low-stock threshold (administrators only).

get.description: Read open shortage and refused-acceptance alerts plus the live low-stock list for any staff member.

post.description: Idempotently acknowledge one open alert (any staff role); an already acknowledged alert is a 409.

get.description:
Download the stock, movements, customer-order and purchase-order workbook (any staff member).

Own admission bucket (10 per minute) because it reads thousands of rows. Read only apart from
the audit event `inventory.exported`. Text cells are formula-guarded (`exports.safe_text`).

post.description: Idempotently queue a Google Sheets stock export, or return the one already queued or running.

get.description: Read the latest Sheets export's status, times, row counts and error code (status `none` if never requested).
Read the company's customer orders with their lines, newest first, optionally filtered by status.

post.description: Idempotently confirm a pending order so its reserved stock leaves on-hand (any staff role).
Idempotently cancel a pending or confirmed order with a reason; its stock is released or returned.

get.description: Read the company's purchase orders with their lines, newest first, for any staff member.

post.description: Idempotently record a supplier purchase order in status `ordered` (administrators only).
Idempotently receive goods against a purchase order, raising stock (administrators only).
Idempotently cancel a purchase order that has received nothing (administrators only).

get.description: Return process health only; this does not establish database or external-provider readiness.

ActivityView.title: ActivityView
ActivityView.description: Consequential event summary; private audit details are not part of the read contract.

AdjustmentInput.title: AdjustmentInput
AdjustmentInput.description: Admin command to correct one product's on-hand stock by a signed, non-zero amount with a reason.

AlertCounts.title: AlertCounts
AlertCounts.description: Open alert totals for the navigation badge: stored alerts by kind, live low-stock products, and their sum.

AlertRow.title: AlertRow
AlertRow.description: A stored alert (shortage or refused acceptance) with the product and conversation it names.

AlertsView.title: AlertsView
AlertsView.description: Open stored alerts, the live low-stock list and the counts.

CancelInput.title: CancelInput
CancelInput.description: Staff command to cancel an order; the reason (3-200 characters) is stored and audited.

CatalogHit.title: CatalogHit
CatalogHit.description: One current tenant-scoped descriptive record with original-page and source-version provenance, without prices.

CatalogSearch.title: CatalogSearch
CatalogSearch.description: A staff/agent search with optional explicit specification constraints; similarity never proves equivalence.

CompanyView.title: CompanyView
CompanyView.description: Authorized company identity and the honest synthetic-data disclosure.

ConversationDetail.title: ConversationDetail
ConversationDetail.description: Canonical inbox detail returned after authorization and current membership checks.

ConversationView.title: ConversationView
ConversationView.description: Staff-visible request state; version is the optimistic mutation precondition.

Decision.title: Decision
Decision.description: Staff review command bound to the expected immutable quotation revision.

DeliveryView.title: DeliveryView
DeliveryView.description: Durable delivery outcome; provider submission and customer delivery remain distinct.

terms.title: Terms
terms.default: Delivery date subject to staff confirmation.

DraftInput.title: DraftInput
DraftInput.description: Validated quotation-edit command with optimistic version, product selections, and bounded commercial adjustments.

Intake.title: Intake
Intake.description: Local-test request input; the API determines company, channel, recipient identity, and authority.

JobView.title: JobView
JobView.description: A bounded job status with a safe failure code, excluding provider payloads.

LevelView.title: LevelView
LevelView.description: A product's ledger position after an adjustment or a reorder-level change.

MessageView.title: MessageView
MessageView.description: Plain text or an authorized media reference; never a public raw-file capability.

MovementRow.title: MovementRow
MovementRow.description: One append-only stock movement with its product identity and optional reference (order or purchase order).

MovementsPage.title: MovementsPage
MovementsPage.description: A newest-first page of movements; `next` is the opaque `before` cursor of the following page, or null.

OrderLineRow.title: OrderLineRow
OrderLineRow.description: One order line copied from the accepted quotation: prices are the quoted ones, never recomputed.

OrderRow.title: OrderRow
OrderRow.description: A customer order with its lines and lifecycle stamps (pending, confirmed or cancelled).

OrdersView.title: OrdersView
OrdersView.description: Orders newest first (at most 200), pending ones included, each with its lines.

Ownership.title: Ownership
Ownership.description: Versioned staff command to pause automation or explicitly return a conversation to the agent.

ProductView.title: ProductView
ProductView.description:
Validated catalog and commercial snapshot fields; embeddings are never sent to the UI.

`available` is on hand minus reserved from the stock ledger, not a stored product column.

PurchaseLineInput.title: PurchaseLineInput
PurchaseLineInput.description: One ordered product: how many and what each unit costs (informational; cost does not value stock).

PurchaseLineRow.title: PurchaseLineRow
PurchaseLineRow.description: A purchase-order line with ordered and received quantities.

PurchaseOrderInput.title: PurchaseOrderInput
PurchaseOrderInput.description: Admin command to record a supplier purchase order (status `ordered`).

PurchaseOrderRow.title: PurchaseOrderRow
PurchaseOrderRow.description: A purchase order with its lines; status moves ordered -> partially_received -> received, or ordered -> cancelled.

PurchaseOrdersView.title: PurchaseOrdersView
PurchaseOrdersView.description: Purchase orders newest first (at most 200), each with its lines.

QuoteContentView.title: QuoteContentView
QuoteContentView.description: Server-calculated totals and terms; browser inputs never determine the monetary result.

QuoteLineView.title: QuoteLineView
QuoteLineView.description: Canonical persisted line used identically in review and PDF output.

QuoteView.title: QuoteView
QuoteView.description: An immutable quotation revision and its separately observed delivery summary.

ReceiveInput.title: ReceiveInput
ReceiveInput.description: Admin command to receive part or all of a purchase order; each line adds to `quantity_received`.

ReceiveLineInput.title: ReceiveLineInput
ReceiveLineInput.description: Goods that arrived for one product of the purchase order in this delivery.

ReorderLevelInput.title: ReorderLevelInput
ReorderLevelInput.description: Admin command to set the low-stock threshold of one product (0..100000).

Selection.title: Selection
Selection.description: A staff-selected product identity and bounded integral quantity; prices always come from the server.

SheetExportView.title: SheetExportView
SheetExportView.description:
Progress of the Google Sheets stock export: `none` before the first request, then queued,
claimed (Apps Script is writing), done (with row counts per tab) or failed (with a short error code).

SourceView.title: SourceView
SourceView.description: An authorized catalog reference without its private Storage path.

StaffReply.title: StaffReply
StaffReply.description: A bounded human reply tied to the staff-owned conversation version, never a quotation approval command.

StockRow.title: StockRow
StockRow.description: One product's stock position: available is on_hand minus reserved, `low` means at or below its reorder level.

StockView.title: StockView
StockView.description: The stock table plus how many products are low.

TextInput.title: TextInput
TextInput.description: Bounded plain-text input with undeclared fields rejected at the API boundary.

UsageView.title: UsageView
UsageView.description: Estimated plus reserved allowance, explicitly distinct from provider-billed cost.

WorkspaceView.title: WorkspaceView
WorkspaceView.description: Validated workspace response consumed by the generated frontend contracts.
